query:
SELECT 
  d.id,
  d.name,
  d.mbtiType->'$.type' as mbti,
  LEFT(d.personality, 30) as personality_preview
FROM digital_twins d
WHERE d.personality IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.id;
